card.name: Words leading into a time span
card.fires_on: Small linking or timing words right before a stated time period, such as 'as' in 'as soon as 48 hours', 'especially' before 'during the initial few months', or 'Day' before a day number.

modes.label: Before a time span
modes.description: A linking word that comes just before a duration or onset time.
modes.example: oligohydramnios has been infrequently reported as soon<< as>> 48 hours after NSAID initiation

modes.label: Especially before early treatment period
modes.description: The word 'especially' just before 'during the initial few months' of therapy.
modes.example: emergence of suicidal thoughts and behaviors,<< especially>> during the initial few months of drug therapy

modes.label: Start or day word before timing
modes.description: Verbs like started or initiated, or the word Day, just before a time detail.
modes.example: Hemodialysis, even when<< initiated>> four hours after the overdosage,

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with a time word, especially calendar month names, and away from 'months' and 'tonight' style words.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before the label gives a time frame, like 'as soon as' or 'especially during the first few months'.
